title: Show HN: KiviDB, a faster Redis-compatible memory database and vector cache
summary: KiviDB is a Redis-compatible in-memory database and vector cache written in Rust, designed to eliminate GC pauses and memory blow-up issues that the author experienced with Dragonfly. The project aims to combine the best aspects of Rust, Garnet, and Dragonfly into a high-performance database solution.
problem_solved: Addresses GC pauses and memory management issues in high-performance in-memory databases during snapshots and heavy workloads
why_valuable: Provides a production-ready alternative to Redis and Dragonfly with predictable latency and no GC interruptions for demanding caching and vector operations
